claims.text: Orbital cellulitis: empiric IV vancomycin (MRSA) + a broad-spectrum β-lactam
claims.quote: Common empiric intravenous regimens for patients with normal renal function include vancomycin for MRSA coverage plus one broad-spectrum β-lactam antibiotic.

claims.text: Metronidazole may be added for anaerobic coverage
claims.quote: Metronidazole may be added to any of these agents to increase anaerobic coverage.
